capabilities: Join two selected adjacent PDF quote callouts into one callout
Preview the joined Markdown and resolved PDF path before applying
Keep distinct source wiki links, deduplicating exact duplicate header links
Reject incompatible pairs (mixed PDFs, different callout types, intervening text)
Find eligible pairs and save named join formats (Pro)
disambiguation: It edits only the note text; it does not join PDF files or merge highlights in the PDF viewer.
extras: Freemium: the join and preview commands are free; pair scanning and named formats require a GitHub Sponsors sponsorship ($5/month or $15 once) plus GitHub sign-in via device flow. The post-update tab promotes other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat. The README lists untested areas (mobile, Linux/Windows runs, PDF++ format variants, concurrent sync edits).
problem: Quotes saved from PDFs sit as separate callouts per page, and merging them by hand risks losing or duplicating the source page links.

relations.evidence: Does it support PDF++ output? It supports the documented simple callout input above.

summary: Command that joins two adjacent PDF quote callouts into one, keeping distinct source page links, with a preview, undo and eligibility checks.
